settings.absence.absence-type.preset-exp: Time off is a special absence type for which only one can exist per company. Work hours past a certain number is automatically added to available time off.
In Norway, self-certification can be taken for up to 3 days at a time, up to 4 times per year. This number resets one calendar year after the self-certification is taken.

In Norway, employees can use self-certification to care for a sick child. The number of days available varies based on the number of children under 13 years old, the number of caregivers, and whether a child has a chronic illness. The number of days resets every January 1st.
Details about employees' children and dependent status must be set in absence settings.
The Norwegian vacation model allows for 25 days of paid vacation per year. This number resets every January 1st.
